frequency_question: How often does the Reserve Bank of India deploy an iCRR mechanism within any given four-month window?
membership_rule: Includes any formal RBI directive implementing an incremental cash reserve ratio or temporary high-powered reserve requirement targeting specific deposit growth. Excludes standard regular CRR adjustments across the board.

cases.name: RBI ad-hoc incremental reserve requirement during 2006 liquidity surge

provenance_note: claims 78 cases from only 2 named (39.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 2 named episodes identified where specific incremental reserve ratios were utilized to absorb sudden liquidity surges.
known_gaps: Minor administrative liquidity management directives that did not formally use the 'iCRR' nomenclature but served similar functions might be undercounted.
skeleton: RBI tightening cycles resulting in targeted liquidity overhang removal over 26 years
multiplier: 2 events across roughly 78 distinct 4-month windows of acute liquidity stress
validity_reason: Central bank operational toolkits for liquidity management evolve slowly over multi-year policy frameworks.
